summary: CRUD plus status transitions plus safe-write rollback that govern how cards change over time.

domain.overview:
Owns the workflows that mutate cards: create, update, delete, rename, bulk-create, bulk-sync from
files, and status transitions (draft to active to drifted to retired). Enforces parent-child rules
at write time, runs the activation guard when promoting a card to active, and wraps multi-step
writes (file plus DB plus annotations) in a rollback-capable safe-write boundary so partial failures
cannot leave the system in an inconsistent state.
domain.scope:
IN: createCard, updateCard, deleteCard, renameCard, bulkCreateCards, bulkSyncCards, status transition
rules including activation guard, parent reassignment cascade, rename FK cascade, safe-write rollback
wrapper, conflict and not-found error mapping.

OUT: schema validation itself (delegated to card-model), low-level repository SQL (delegated to
card-storage), code-link resolution (delegated to code-binding).

cross_domain_dependencies.relationship: invokes type-specific validators before any write reaches storage.
persists mutations through repositories and triggers file-DB synchronization.
